artboards.title: General Information - as it ships today

annotations.text: Row 1 gains a New Study button: it saves a clean copy of the workbook, every input cleared and every alternative removed, so the next project starts from a blank form. The sheet buttons stay where they are at rows 44 to 52.

The how-to card is cut off mid-sentence today because columns F to J are 8.7 characters each, so five numbered lines wrap to nine inside a 43-character merge. F to J go to 13 characters and the rows get taller.

Today the empty input cells share one grey fill with no edges, so four separate fields read as a single block. Giving each a box border separates them without moving any cell: every input keeps its address.
